description: Prompt engineering means writing and testing clear requests for AI tools. Practise goals, source text, examples and checks with everyday tasks and honest missing-information answers. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
whatYouWillLearn: Explain use an example for an exact pattern
learningObjectives: Practise ask for missing information honestly
Practise break a large job into checkable steps
Practise revise one issue at a time

seo.title: Prompt Engineering Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn Prompt Engineering with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
